description: This file defines the TemplateAddressCountry class, which extends the TemplateEnum class. It is a template for a country address field in the SuiteCRM application, including a method to retrieve field definitions with specific options and group details.

classes.name: TemplateAddressCountry
classes.description: A class representing a country address field template, extending the TemplateEnum class with additional properties and methods for field definition.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array with 'group' and 'options' parameters set for this country address template.
